newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp unhappy with Utah rate cut plan.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp unhappy with Utah rate cut plan.

text.p: PacifiCorp on Wednesday said it was disappointed with the state of Utah's proposal for an immediate reduction in electricity prices.

"The rush to take the company into an extensive rate hearing just as the electric utility industry is poised on the verge of major changes is unjustified," Verl Topham, PacifiCorp's general counsel, said.

The Utah Division of Public Utilities proposed an immediate hearing before the state's public service commission to seek a temporary $12.4 million cut in electricity rates, or about 1.75 percent on customer bills, PacifiCorp said.
